'''TB-278''' was the designation of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], TB-278 was among those sent to retrieve a captured [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. Upon the orders of his [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Delaya)|officer]], TB-278 and his squad opened fire and killed [[J'er Nahj]] and [[Halle Dray]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] who originally captured Organa. TB-278 and [[TB-137]] were then sent to hunt down [[Kiro Chen]], another captor of Organa that managed to escape.<ref name="hostage" />
